newsitem.title: HUNGARY: COLLAPSING HOUSE KILLS THREE CHILDREN IN HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: COLLAPSING HOUSE KILLS THREE CHILDREN IN HUNGARY.

text.p: A collapsing house buried under a family on Saturday in the western Hungarian town Szekesfehervar, killing three children, the National Fire-Brigade (NFB) told Reuters.
"It was a house ahead of demolition, and a homeless gipsy family moved in," said NFB spokeswoman Ildiko Puskas.
The firemen rescued an elderly woman and a child alive from the collapsed house, but three other children the searching dogs found under the ruins were already dead, she said.
Millions of gipsies live in Hungary and the neighbouring countries, with the rate of unemployed and those living in poverty much higher among them then average.
